newsitem.title: USA: AOL says latest lawsuit has no merit.
newsitem.headline: AOL says latest lawsuit has no merit.

text.p: America Online Inc said that, although it has not yet been served with a lawsuit expected to be filed against it in Los Angeles soon, a spokeswoman said there is no merit to the suit, which alleges racketeering violations by the online services giant.
"When the law changes and plaintiffs have to pay for frivolous lawsuits, suits like this won't be filed anymore," said an AOL spokeswoman. "There is no merit to this lawsuit."
Lawyers at Stanbury & Fishelman Inc said Thursday they were filing a suit against AOL, seeking over $100 million in damages, relating to its recent network problems.
